pair.Description: Dyad identifier. The two participants sharing a pair value were recorded simultaneously on a single Brain Products amplifier and are sample-aligned across brains. Within a pair the odd-numbered subject is participant 1 (Fp1..Iz) and the even-numbered subject is participant 2 (Fp1_2..Iz_2 in the source data).

partner.Description: participant_id of the other member of this participant's dyad.

age_band.Description: Self-reported age bracket in years (questionnaire Part 1 Q2).

acquaintance_length.Description: How long the participant had known their dyad partner before the experiment (questionnaire Part 1 Q3).
